Name: Maachah, Daughter of Absalom
Summary: Maachah, daughter of Absalom, was Rehoboam's favoured wife and mother of Abijah; Asa later removed her from being queen because she had made an idol in a grove. Also known as Maachah, Queen Mother.
KeyStory: Rehoboam loved Maachah above all his wives, made her son Abijah chief among his brethren, and years later Asa cut down and burnt her idol at the brook Kidron.
RelatedPeople: Rehoboam; Absalom; Abijah, King of Judah; King Asa; Abijam, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Favour in a palace is no shelter from God's judgment on idolatry, even for a queen mother.
